use_when: the current host lacks required external tool/service access and an MCP server is a better fit than a local library or native tool
avoid_when: the host already exposes the required capability
a repository-local script/library is simpler and safer

notes: Discover candidate servers from first-party sources or the Official MCP Registry.
Configure the selected server using the current host's native MCP configuration; do not install unrelated servers.

credentials: provider-specific only when the selected MCP server requires them
permissions: least-privilege read/write scope appropriate to the selected server

checks: confirm the host can connect to the server
confirm the original capability gap is closed

steps: remove/disable the server entry from the host MCP configuration
revoke any provider credential created only for this integration

warnings: Discovery is not installation; inspect publisher, permissions, data egress, and write scope before connection.
